content.premise: Doune Castle stands dressed as it was when the Duke of Albany kept it: fires laid, tables set, the portcullis raised. A guide meets the visitors on the north approach and leads them through the gate, the halls, the kitchen and up onto the wall-walk, telling the castle's six centuries as they go. Every door is open; the guide waits at each stop for whoever wants the story.
content.theme: A working medieval courtyard castle, walked room by room behind a guide who knows every stone.
content.title: Doune Castle: A Guided Tour
